description: This file defines the SplashActivity class for an Android application. It serves as the entry point (launch activity) that displays a splash screen with minimal UI for approximately 3 seconds before navigating to the MainActivity. It manages a delayed transition using a Handler and Runnable, ensuring the UI remains responsive. The class also ensures cleanup by removing callbacks in onDestroy.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays a splash screen upon app launch and navigates to the main screen after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the splash theme and layout, and sets up a delayed navigation to MainActivity.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up handler callbacks to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
